codes.*: rating marked * = district absent from that forecaster's non-safe table, so Safe/Solid by inference
codes.lines: new = district redrawn for 2026 (pres24 is new-lines DRA estimate via 270toWin; house24 is the 2024 result in the old same-numbered district); same = 2024 lines still in use
codes.pres_basis: how the pres24 winner sign was set: xover = 270toWin crossover list (winner = 2024 House winner's party unless listed); wiki = Wikipedia district/state article; pvi = inferred from Cook PVI (source margin unsigned); unconfirmed = sign not found
codes.margins: D+x / R+x = winner's margin in points
codes.candidates: 270toWin lists D first, R second without labels; parties confirmed on Wikipedia (OH, FL-7, FL-9, TX-9) and RCP (AK), otherwise by incumbent party/listing order
codes.poll: array of public general-election polls since 2026-08-01 found on 270toWin district pages or RCP; 'listed' = the single date 270toWin shows; empty = none found (270toWin 404 treated as none)
